statement: CoreWeave's public pricing page lists on-demand NVIDIA HGX H100 capacity at $49.24 per hour, with no prior rate shown for comparison.
why: This is a static published rental level with no stated baseline or change, so it functions as a price overlay on GPU rental economics rather than a directional demand or supply signal.

impact.mechanism: Published neocloud on-demand rates set the visible rental cost of NVIDIA accelerators and anchor committed-contract negotiations, without by itself indicating a change in either direction.

evidence.excerpt: NVIDIA HGX H100: $49.24 per hour on-demand.
up to 60% discounts over our On-Demand prices for committed usage

confidence.basis: Vendor list page read live and classified secondary tier; no reserved-contract figures are published and no prior rates appear, so no change can be established.

dispersion: North America on-demand per hour: HGX H100 $49.24, HGX H200 $50.44, GB200 NVL72 $42.00, HGX B200 $68.80; committed usage discounted up to 60%.
